#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression test for the github.action_ref -> callisto@<version> resolution
# in scripts/install-callisto.sh: a workflow pinned to
# `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` (or setup-callisto the same way)
# must install X.Y.Z, not whatever GitHub Releases calls "latest". Extracts
# the snippet by real text anchors so this test always exercises the
# script's current logic.
set -u
ACTION_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
INSTALL_SCRIPT="$ACTION_DIR/scripts/install-callisto.sh"

extract_snippet() {
  sed -n '/^TAG_NAME="\$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"$/,/^# Validate verification mode$/p' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT" \
    | sed '$d'
}

# Runs the extracted snippet with INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION/GITHUB_ACTION_REF set
# and `git ls-remote` stubbed to print tag_lines; prints the resulting
# TAG_NAME and records every git invocation.
run_case() {
  local input_version="$1" action_ref="$2" tag_lines="$3"
  local tmp_script calls_file
  tmp_script="$(mktemp)"
  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
  {
    printf 'git() { echo "git $*" >> %q; if [[ "$1 $2" == "ls-remote --tags" ]]; then printf %%s %q; fi; }\n' \
      "$calls_file" "$tag_lines"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION=%q\n' "$input_version"
    [[ -n "$action_ref" ]] && printf 'GITHUB_ACTION_REF=%q\n' "$action_ref"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE=auto\n'
    extract_snippet
    printf 'echo "TAG_NAME=$TAG_NAME"\n'
  } > "$tmp_script"
  bash "$tmp_script"
  echo "---CALLS---"
  cat "$calls_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$calls_file"
}

fail=0
TAGS=$'deadbeef00000000000000000000000000000001\trefs/tags/callisto@0.7.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0^{}\n'

# 1. No action ref set (local/unpinned invocation): stays "latest", no git call.
out=$(run_case "latest" "" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"git ls-remote"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_no_action_ref_stays_latest_without_git_call: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_no_action_ref_stays_latest_without_git_call"
fi

# 2. Action ref matches a published callisto@ tag: resolved, dereferenced ^{} ignored.
out=$(run_case "latest" "abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_matching_action_ref_resolves_to_tag: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_matching_action_ref_resolves_to_tag"
fi

# 3. Action ref matches no tag: falls back to true latest.
out=$(run_case "latest" "0000000000000000000000000000000000000f" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_unmatched_action_ref_falls_back_to_latest: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_unmatched_action_ref_falls_back_to_latest"
fi

# 3b. A named ref (the floating v1 tag) resolves through the commit it points at, lightweight or annotated.
FLOATING=$'abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/v1\nfeed000000000000000000000000000000000003\trefs/tags/v2\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/v2^{}\n'
out=$(run_case "latest" "v1" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_floating_tag_ref_resolves_to_its_release: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_floating_tag_ref_resolves_to_its_release"
fi
out=$(run_case "latest" "v2" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.8.0"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_annotated_floating_tag_ref_uses_its_peeled_commit: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_annotated_floating_tag_ref_uses_its_peeled_commit"
fi
out=$(run_case "latest" "v9" "$FLOATING")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=latest"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_unknown_named_ref_falls_back_to_latest: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_unknown_named_ref_falls_back_to_latest"
fi

# 4. Explicit version override is never touched, even with a resolvable action ref.
out=$(run_case "callisto@0.5.0" "abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002" "$TAGS")
if [[ "$out" != *"TAG_NAME=callisto@0.5.0"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"git ls-remote"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL test_explicit_version_override_skips_resolution: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS test_explicit_version_override_skips_resolution"
fi

run_installer() (
  local source="$1" version="$2" checkout="$3" action_ref="${4:-}"
  local fixture code
  fixture=$(mktemp -d)
  fixture=$(cd "$fixture" && pwd -P)
  export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$fixture/checkout with spaces" RUNNER_TEMP="$fixture/runner"
  export GITHUB_PATH="$fixture/github-path" GITHUB_ACTION_REF="$action_ref"
  export INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source" INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION="$version" INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION=skip
  mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src" "$RUNNER_TEMP"
  printf '# consumer depends on callisto-cli\n' > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml"
  : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml"
  : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs"
  : > "$fixture/calls"
  git() {
    echo "git $*" >> "$fixture/calls"
    case "$*" in
      ls-remote*) printf '%s' "$TAGS" ;;
      *rev-parse*) [[ "$checkout" != untracked ]] && printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ;;
      *ls-files*) [[ "$checkout" != untracked ]] ;;
      *) return 99 ;;
    esac
  }
  cargo() {
    echo "cargo $*" >> "$fixture/calls"
    case "$1" in
      metadata)
        [[ "$checkout" != metadata-failure ]] || return 1
        command jq -n --arg root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --arg mode "$checkout" '
          {workspace_root: (if $mode == "foreign-root" then $root + "/other" else $root end),
           workspace_members: (if $mode == "nonmember" then [] else ["cli-id"] end),
           packages: [{id: "cli-id", name: "callisto-cli", source: null,
             manifest_path: (if $mode == "dependency" then "/registry/Cargo.toml"
               else $root + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml" end),
             targets: [{name: "callisto", kind: ["bin"],
               src_path: (if $mode == "foreign-target" then "/other/main.rs"
                 else $root + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs" end)}]}]}'
        ;;
      build) ;;
      install) [[ "$checkout" != install-failure ]] ;;
      *) return 99 ;;
    esac
  }
  jq() { echo "jq $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; command jq "$@"; }
  uname() { [[ "$1" == -s ]] && echo Linux || echo x86_64; }
  curl() { echo "curl $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 1; }
  gh() { echo "unexpected gh $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  tar() { echo "unexpected tar $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  unzip() { echo "unexpected unzip $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }
  cp() { echo "cp $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; }
  (cd "$fixture" && source "$INSTALL_SCRIPT")
  code=$?
  cat "$fixture/calls"
  rm -rf "$fixture"
  return "$code"
)

for checkout in dependency owned; do
  out=$(run_installer auto callisto@0.5.0 "$checkout"); code=$?
  if [[ $code -ne 0 || "$out" != *"cargo install callisto-cli --version 0.5.0 "* \
    || "$out" == *"cargo build"* || "$out" == *"cargo metadata"* || "$out" == *"git ls-remote"* ]]; then
    echo "FAIL auto_explicit_pin_$checkout: code=$code out=$out"; fail=1
  else
    echo "PASS auto_explicit_pin_$checkout"
  fi
done

out=$(run_installer auto latest owned abc1230000000000000000000000000000000002); code=$?
if [[ $code -ne 0 || "$out" != *"cargo install callisto-cli --version 0.8.0 "* || "$out" == *"cargo build"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL auto_action_ref_pin_owned: code=$code out=$out"; fail=1
else

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression test for the github.action_ref -> callisto@<version> resolution
# in scripts/install-callisto.sh: a workflow pinned to
# `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` (or setup-callisto the same way)
# must install X.Y.Z, not whatever GitHub Releases calls "latest". Extracts
# the snippet by real text anchors so this test always exercises the
# script's current logic.
set -u
ACTION_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
INSTALL_SCRIPT="$ACTION_DIR/scripts/install-callisto.sh"

extract_snippet() {
  sed -n '/^TAG_NAME="\$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"$/,/^# Validate verification mode$/p' "$INSTALL_SCRIPT" \
    | sed '$d'
}

# Runs the extracted snippet with INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION/GITHUB_ACTION_REF set
# and `git ls-remote` stubbed to print tag_lines; prints the resulting
# TAG_NAME and records every git invocation.
run_case() {
  local input_version="$1" action_ref="$2" tag_lines="$3"
  local tmp_script calls_file
  tmp_script="$(mktemp)"
  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
  {
    printf 'git() { echo "git $*" >> %q; if [[ "$1 $2" == "ls-remote --tags" ]]; then printf %%s %q; fi; }\n' \
      "$calls_file" "$tag_lines"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION=%q\n' "$input_version"
    [[ -n "$action_ref" ]] && printf 'GITHUB_ACTION_REF=%q\n' "$action_ref"
    printf 'INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE=auto\n'
    extract_snippet
    printf 'echo "TAG_NAME=$TAG_NAME"\n'
  } > "$tmp_script"
  bash "$tmp_script"
  echo "---CALLS---"
  cat "$calls_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$calls_file"
}

fail=0
TAGS=$'deadbeef00000000000000000000000000000001\trefs/tags/callisto@0.7.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0\nabc1230000000000000000000000000000000002\trefs/tags/callisto@0.8.0^{}\n'

# 1. No action ref set (local/unpinned invocation): stays "latest", no git call.
out=$(run_case "latest" "" "$TAGS")

  echo "FAIL test_no_action_ref_stays_latest_without_git_call: $out"; fail=1
else

fi

fi

else
  echo "PASS test_unknown_named_ref_falls_back_to_latest"

  unzip() { echo "unexpected unzip $*" >> "$fixture/calls"; return 99; }

# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag. A named ref such
# as the floating `v1` tag stands for the commit it points at.

  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1

STOPPED, NOT DONE: running the shell test wiped the worktree's files, and I could not restore them. Nothing is staged and no deliverable is usable.

**What went wrong**
- `.github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh` calls `fixture=$(mktemp -d)`, then `rm -rf "$fixture"`, in `run_installer`. In this sandbox `mktemp` failed ("Operation not permitted" under `/var/folders/...`). `$TMPDIR` is `/tmp/claude-501` in my shell.
- With `fixture` empty, the script's `cd "$fixture" && pwd -P` resolved to the current directory, which was the worktree. The `rm -rf` then deleted the working tree.
- The sandbox blocked deletion of `.claude/` and `.git`. Everything else is gone, including all my edits.
- `/usr/bin/git status --short` shows 441 tracked files as ` D` (deleted in the worktree, not staged). Their content is intact in git objects.
- I tried `/usr/bin/git restore --worktree -- .` to recover. The auto-mode classifier denied it as "Irreversible Local Destruction". I did not try another route around that.

**What is lost**
- Gone from disk: all uncommitted edits and the untracked files, including `target/` if it lived inside the worktree.
- Still intact: the branch `fix/commit-plan-bytes-and-latest-fallback` and its commits, and `.git`, which is a gitdir pointer.
- Untracked files that were never in git are unrecoverable. The tree was clean at start, so those can only have been ignored files such as `target/`.

**Decision for you**
Either allow `/usr/bin/git restore --worktree -- .` in this worktree, or restore the files yourself. Then I can redo the work. The lost edits were small and I know them.

**Before the shell test is run again**
- Run the shell test only with a guard (`[[ -n "$fixture" ]]`), or point `TMPDIR` at a writable directory first.
- Do not run the shell test again as it stands in this sandbox. It can repeat the wipe if `mktemp` fails again.

**What the lost work did (for redo)**

REL-PR-03, `crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/access.rs`:
- `staged_changes_since` now reads worktree bytes only when `entry.new_mode == Some(REGULAR_FILE_MODE)`, imported from `crate::release_pr`. Any other mode (symlink 120000, submodule 160000, 100755) gets `contents: None`. `ReleasePrCommitPlanV1::from_changes` then rejects it with E150 before any read, instead of E059 or a generic git error.
- `verify_staged_blob` now runs `git hash-object --no-filters -- <path>`. The existing fake-runner expectations in `access.rs` were updated to match.
- The `StagedChangeV1.contents` doc comment in `release_pr.rs` was updated.
- New real-git tests in `crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/tests.rs`:
  - A staged symlink (unix only) gives `UnsupportedFileMode { mode: 0o120000 }`.
  - A submodule added with `update-index --cacheinfo 160000` gives `UnsupportedFileMode { mode: 0o160000 }`.
  - With `core.autocrlf=true` and a CRLF file, the read returns `StagedContentMismatch`. This test discriminates: without `--no-filters` that case passes silently.
- `cargo nextest run -p callisto-model staged_` passed 7 of 7 before the wipe.
- Spec: `docs/specs/release.json` REL-PR-03 now says regular-file bytes are hashed without filters, filter-changed bytes fail E059, and a symlink or submodule fails E150 before any content is read.

REL-PR-06, `.github/actions/setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh`:
- The line `git ls-remote ... 2>/dev/null) || true` became `if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote ...); then echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"; exit 1; fi`.
- The no-match fallback is unchanged, and the header comment was updated.
- Planned test in `test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh`: `run_case` takes an `ls-remote` exit status and echoes `EXIT=$?`. A new case 3a expects the error text and `EXIT=1` with no `TAG_NAME=` printed.
- Spec: REL-PR-06 gets "A failed tag lookup fails the step."
- The shell test was never run successfully, because the wipe happened on the first run.

**Not done**
- Neither the clippy, fmt, `just workflow-contracts` nor changeset step was run, and nothing was staged.
- A changeset is warranted for the user-visible release-pr and setup-callisto behaviour change. The planned command was `cargo run -q -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/callisto-cli:patch --summary "<...>"`.

**PR body (draft, unverified until redone)**

`release-pr commit-plan` now hashes the worktree bytes with git filters off, so a line-ending or clean filter can no longer make the check pass against bytes that differ from the staged blob. It also decides the file mode before reading content, so a staged symlink or submodule path fails with the unsupported-mode error instead of a content-mismatch or generic git error.

`setup-callisto` no longer swallows a failed `git ls-remote` when resolving the action ref: a failed lookup fails the step with a clear message, while an unset ref or one that matches no tag still falls back to the latest release.

Verified with real-git tests (symlink, submodule, `core.autocrlf` with a CRLF file) and a new shell case for the failed lookup; the release spec criteria are updated to match.

The PR body is only valid once the work is redone and verified.
